BiblicalUsage: Desolation in Scripture is not only ruin, it is ruin that leaves onlookers staring. Moses warns that Israel shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all nations, and Jeremiah says Jerusalem shall be made desolate and an hissing, with every passer-by astonished. Babylon shall become heaps, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant, and Judah was delivered to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as Hezekiah confessed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe astonishment is the end of a people that will not listen, because their ruin becomes a lesson for everyone who passes by. The hissing of the nations is God's sermon on a city that refused His word. That is why I take the warnings as mercy, because they are given before the ruin comes.
